name: NGC 1132 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1132, a giant elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1132-hubble
story: This giant elliptical is a cosmic fossil, most likely what remains of a group of galaxies that merged together. Thousands of ancient globular clusters swarm around it, probably survivors of the galaxies it swallowed.

claims.text: NGC 1132 is a giant elliptical galaxy
NGC 1132 and its dwarf companions are a fossil group, likely the remains of merged galaxies
Thousands of ancient globular clusters surround it
The globular clusters are likely survivors of disrupted parent galaxies
This pointing is NGC 1132 in a fossil-group program
